ios.desc:
Turn any flyer, screenshot, or schedule into a calendar event in seconds.

Snap a photo, upload from your camera roll, or paste a screenshot of a flyer, invite, poster, or schedule. EventScan's AI reads the date, time, and location and builds a ready-to-save event.

KEY FEATURES
• Automatic Event Detection: pulls title, date, time, and location from any photo or screenshot
• Multi-Event Scanning: detects several events in one image, great for full schedules and rosters
• One-Tap Add: sends events straight to Apple Calendar or Google Calendar
• Share & Export: send events by iMessage or export as a universal .ics file
• Event History: review, edit, and re-add anything you've scanned before

PERFECT FOR
· Parties, concerts, and festivals
· Work schedules and shift rosters
· School and class timetables 
· Flights and travel itineraries
· Invitations and save-the-dates

Free to start: scan up to 5 events a month at no cost. Upgrade to EventScan Pro for unlimited scans.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: EventSnap – Place flyers on your calendar

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I just launched an app, EventSnap. It takes a photo of an event flyer or invite and turns it into an event on your iCloud or Google Calendar.

It's free and currently only for iPhone (was using this idea to gain familiarity with swift, sorry haha)

Just got AppStore approval, as always, any comments or feedback are very much welcome
